name: Chromium in GD
description: A Chromium (CEF) browser rendered inside Geometry Dash with tabs, audio, microphone access, Discord support, and DevTools. Works in fullscreen.

toggle-keybind.name: Toggle Browser
toggle-keybind.description: Show or hide the browser window.

home-page.name: Home Page
home-page.description: Page the first tab opens when the browser starts.

new-tab-page.name: New Tab Page
new-tab-page.description: Page that newly opened tabs show. (Chrome's real new-tab page does not exist in the embedded browser, so Google is the closest equivalent.)

allow-microphone.name: Allow Microphone and Camera
allow-microphone.description: Automatically grants microphone/camera requests to pages you open. Disable this if you do not trust a site.

keep-running-hidden.name: Keep Tabs Running While Hidden
keep-running-hidden.description: Keeps voice chat and audio alive when the browser frame is hidden.
